comment: Source read at commit 95496e8 ("Version 2.1.0. Added Categories."), the HEAD of https://github.com/expertsleepersltd/vcvrack-encoders; its plugin.json is byte-for-byte the installed 2.1.0 manifest. Each input is sampled once per eight process calls rather than every sample: 8CV.cpp:18-19 derive a phase state and a DAC index, and line 25 reads inputs[dac] only when the state is 0. The panel prints the inputs 1 to 8, which are indices 0 to 7. The clip limits are -2048 and 2047 counts, so the positive limit is fractionally lower than the negative one; both are quoted as about 5.33V. The local smuxProof at 8CV.cpp:30 is hardcoded false, so the phase increment is always 2 and the alternative branch can never run. No family is given for the output because it carries a coded word rather than a signal of any of the four kinds.
